family: F7i: F3i fast improve-maker on BTC 5m + alt-book pull trigger
base: exactly frozen/F3i.json (event, improve one tick inside a >= 2-tick spread, one live order per side, post-only BUY 5, hold to settlement, pess)
alt_trigger: for each ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE 5m market of the same window: dm = UP mid now - UP mid 500 ms earlier (at each alt book row). If we bid UP on BTC: cancel at the first alt row with dm <= -THR after our decision; if we offer UP (bid DOWN): first alt row with dm >= +THR. Cancel lands alt row + book + cancel ms.
note: join-mode F7 runs were killed by the 800 MB cap at 20:47/20:50 (all rows held in memory); fixed (per-hour flush) and rerun later
